variants.text: Forty-one out and forty-one back is a count, and a count is kept in a book. Which of them went back different is in two lines nobody thought worth remarking on.
Eleven thousand years of peat at that depth, and iron is four. Something was put in below the band long after the band was made.
Nobody cuts below it. Every cutter can walk to it blindfold. Not one of them can tell you who told them.
